notes.title: VR version update announcement
notes.notes:
Dear visitors
Our VR aquarium has been updated with the following content.

🪼Game content update


 Addition of anomalies that can be encountered
 Addition of "Home Menu"
 Addition of "Anomaly List"
 Addition of "Jellyfish Mania" mode
 Addition of achievements that can be earned


🪼Function corrections and changes


 Addition of a device that reacts when the VR controller is held over it


🪼Confirmed bugs


 When hidden items are unlocked in the home menu, there is no rotation animation.
 Achievements related to the "anomaly list" may not be unlocked correctly.
*We plan to fix this in a future update so that achievements are unlocked according to the completion status of the anomaly list.


This is the end of the information from our aquarium.
Please continue to enjoy your stay.

notes.title: "Aquarium at August 32nd VR" early access version released
notes.notes:
Dear visitors

The early access version of "Aquarium at August 32nd VR" will be available from Friday, November 29, 2024.

There are some points to note compared to the desktop PC version, so please see the explanation below.

🪼Playable game content
In the early access version, you can enjoy the following game content.


 Encounter with 30 types of anomalies
 Game play in normal mode


The following content that has been released in the desktop PC version cannot be played due to renovation. Please wait for future updates.


 Home menu
 Anomaly list
 Jellyfish Mania mode


🪼Changes in functions and specifications in the VR version
The following functions are not available in the VR version.


 Gameplay using keyboard and mouse
※ A VR headset (HMD) is required to play the VR version.
 Change graphic settings
※ The game is fixed in window mode with a resolution of "1280x720" so that you can end the game with the "close" button if a problem occurs.
 Pause and option settings during gameplay
 Move and copy save data between the VR version and the desktop PC version


We plan to publish a guide on other points to note when playing the game.
Please take care of your health and relax at "Aquarium at August 32nd VR".
